reference.hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 logical CPUs, 32 GiB RAM
reference.install: Non-editable Bernstein 3.24.1 wheels, frozen uv.lock, matched local fixtures. OS filesystem cache retained. Desktop background work was allowed.
reference.readiness: Required local preflight precedes starting the server. Poll /health/ready for status ready, then require an authenticated /dashboard/data response with stats, tasks and agents. This precedes external work. Record the first agent reported working or idle and the natural CLI exit separately. Each poll interval was 50 ms.
reference.precision: Seconds from process launch, rounded to six decimal places. p95 is the nearest-rank observation for series of at least 50. Exit codes are process return codes.

browser_check.browser: Chromium via the Google Chrome channel
browser_check.initial_login_observation: On the repaired runtime, an anonymous tasks request that remained in flight during sign-in could leave the tasks panel showing an access error. Clicking the visible Retry button fetched authenticated task data. The diagnostic exercised both ordinary sign-in and forced early sign-in with recovery.

bootstrap_output_verification.fixtures: Installed wheels in isolated homes. The real CLI ran seed and inline-goal bootstrap paths with unavailable server, occupied port, missing CLI or missing adapter. The timeout fixture simulates a failed readiness probe and advances the wait clock. Each case ran with stderr piped and with stderr attached to a real POSIX pseudo-terminal. The two ordinary display controls check for Rich on a terminal.

separate_ordinary_run.scenario: Separate instrumented ordinary run, omitted from latency summaries

controlled_dashboard_repeat.condition: After the four previous 50-process series and separate browser check finished, repeat only the dashboard scenario. Use the same wheel and sequential fixture, retaining OS caches on a shared development machine. Task participants agreed to launch no competing tests, browsers or probes. Other desktop activity was uncontrolled.
controlled_dashboard_repeat.sample_rule: 50 consecutive fresh projects and empty user homes, all observations retained, natural exits. Each sample records external ready health, authenticated dashboard data and first agent working or idle. Nearest-rank p95; dashboard target 2.000 s.
controlled_dashboard_repeat.reason: Two review fixtures ran during the original dashboard series. One timed out after 12 s. The other completed in 2.390456 s. Both original and repeat series are retained; the overlap does not establish the cause of any given observation.

documentation_after_measurement.classification: Package documentation used to generate the orchestration row of docs/sdd/module-map.md. The only source change since the timed wheel is the package docstring.
